records.name: independent skipped body
records.source:
printf before >before; false && cat <<EOF
$(true |)
EOF
printf after >after

records.name: external malformed substitution
records.source:
printf before >before; cat <<EOF
head $(true |) tail $(printf good >inner; printf good)
EOF
printf 'status=%s' "$?"; printf after >after
records.stderr:
shell: command substitution: line 2: syntax error near unexpected token `)'
shell: command substitution: line 2: `true |) tail $(printf good >inner; printf good)'
